title: Separate immutable evidence history from current status projections
observed_problem: A current status projection still reports S03 open while a later explicit decision approves S03; conversation manifest is one record behind its archive. Historical EEM/source hashes also differ from current files while matching pinned historical commits.
initial_faulty_assumption_or_design_deci: Assuming every status projection and current path describes the newest approved state, or treating every current-path hash difference as damaged evidence.
observable_consequence: A reviewer could incorrectly deny later completed work or invalidate authentic historical evidence.
assessed_root_cause: Status projections and append-only evidence evolved at different commits; a current pathname is not an immutable artifact identity.
chosen_corrective_method: Resolve the governing decision in time; verify path plus commit plus hash; propose separate status updates without rewriting historical evidence.
alternatives_and_negative_results: Do not silently rewrite historical FAIL/OPEN statements
Do not replace evidence using an unpinned newer branch
repeatable_validation: Read git log for replay/stages.json, replay/manifest.json and conversations.jsonl; compare decision and archived bytes without execution.
generalizable_lesson: Audit immutable artifact identities and decision chronology separately from convenience status projections.
applicability: Repositories with append-only records and manually maintained manifests/status files
non_applicability: Does not approve later code or waive missing tests; current mismatches still require individual investigation.
safety_contract_constraints: No baseline, Gate, existing lesson or executable change; no automatic promotion.
author_role: FPGA documentation auditor assisted by AI
